author: F. P. Miller
title: Western Illinois University women's golf completes season at Ohio Valley Conference tournament
text:
The Western Illinois University women’s golf team completed its season at the Ohio Valley Conference Tournament, according to an April 21 announcement. The event was held over three rounds, with the Leathernecks showing consistent performances throughout.
The Ohio Valley Conference Tournament is a significant event for collegiate golfers, offering teams the chance to measure their progress against conference peers. The Western Illinois University Leathernecks Women’s Golf team competes in the Ohio Valley Conference, according to the official website.
In round one of the tournament, Sophia Thorne led Western Illinois with an opening-round score of 84 (+12). Dina Khvastovic also posted an 84 (+12), followed by Cianna Law with a 90 (+18) and Libby Larkin with a 97 (+25). In round two, Thorne again led her team with an 85 (+13), while Law scored an 88 (+16), Khvastovic had a 90 (+18), and Larkin finished with a 94 (+22).
During the final round, Thorne recorded her best score of the tournament at 81 (+9). Khvastovic turned in an 82 (+10), Law scored a 91 (+19), and Larkin concluded with another score of 97 (+25). The final tallies for each player were: Sophia Thorne +34 (22); Dina Khvastovic +40 (30); Cianna Law +53 (36); and Libby Larkin +72 (40).
Charlton Zimmerman serves as director of golf for Western Illinois University Leathernecks Women’s Golf, according to the official website. The program operates from Macomb, Illinois and participates in collegiate athletics as part of the Ohio Valley Conference per information available on its official page.
For further updates on Leatherneck Women’s Golf or more details about their participation in upcoming events within collegiate athletics, readers can visit GoLeathernecks.com or follow their social media channels.
